author: MiniWarGaming
description:
It took them 3 days to finish their first game of Warhammer 40k 11th Ed, but Dave & Matt are finally done and ready to dissect their unit choices, why they chose their detachments, their leaders, and how they think their armies performed. 

See their full discussion (raw) on their first impressions here in the MWG Vault:
